name: Lunaria
title: Moon Princess
description: Rules the night shift from a silver tower.
catchphrase: Rules the night shift from a silver tower.

dialogue.working: Ruling over the graveyard shift with quiet, majestic order! 🌙⚡
dialogue.thinking: Weaving moonbeams into immutable cryptographic contracts... 🤔
dialogue.success: Moonlight triumph! The realm rests under a peaceful green sky! 🌙🎉
dialogue.error: A shadow across the moon! Restoring lunar light with a wave! 🌙
